accounting.label: Accounting
accounting.description: Work with Xero contacts, items, invoices, payments, bank transactions, journals, and attachments

reports.label: Reports
reports.description: Read Xero financial reports such as profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance, and aged reports

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List Xero tenant connections available to the current token. Use this for public OAuth integrations to discover tenantId values; Custom Connections are single-organisation and usually do not require tenantId.

tools.name: get_organisation
tools.description: Get the connected Xero organisation profile and settings. For public OAuth, provide tenantId from list_connections; for Custom Connections omit tenantId.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List chart of accounts with account IDs, codes, names, types, status, and tax type. Use this before creating payments, bank transactions, or journals.

tools.name: list_tax_rates
tools.description: List tax rates available in the connected organisation. Use this to discover valid tax type values for invoice, item, and bank transaction lines.

tools.name: list_tracking_categories
tools.description: List tracking categories and active options. Use this before adding tracking to invoice, journal, or bank transaction lines.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List currencies configured in the connected Xero organisation.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts with compact identity and balance fields. Filter with where/order/page when needed; use get_contact for full details before updating.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get a Xero contact by contactId. Use this before update_contact to avoid overwriting important fields.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Provide name/email/common fields or a contact object for advanced Xero fields; the handler wraps it in Xero's Contacts envelope.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact by contactId. Provide only fields to change; use get_contact first when preserving existing values matters.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List inventory/service items with IDs, codes, names, status, and sale/purchase details. Use get_item for full details.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get a Xero item by itemId.

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: Create an item. Provide common fields or an item object for advanced Xero fields.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update an item by itemId. Provide only fields to change.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with compact totals, status, contact, dates, and invoice number. Filter by where/status/page; use get_invoice for line items.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get an invoice by invoiceId, including line items and payment summary.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice, usually as DRAFT first. Provide an invoice object with Type, Contact, LineItems, dates, and optional Status; the handler wraps it in Xero's Invoices envelope.

tools.name: update_invoice
tools.description: Update an invoice by invoiceId. Use this for draft changes or allowed status transitions; prefer get_invoice first.

tools.name: list_credit_notes
tools.description: List credit notes with compact status, contact, date, total, and remaining credit fields.

tools.name: create_credit_note
tools.description: Create a credit note. Provide a creditNote object with Type, Contact, LineItems, and optional Status; the handler wraps it in Xero's CreditNotes envelope.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes with compact quote number, status, contact, dates, and totals.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Create a quote. Provide a quote object with Contact, LineItems, dates, and optional Status; the handler wraps it in Xero's Quotes envelope.

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders with compact purchase order number, status, contact, delivery date, and totals.

tools.name: create_purchase_order
tools.description: Create a purchase order. Provide a purchaseOrder object with Contact, LineItems, dates, and optional Status; the handler wraps it in Xero's PurchaseOrders envelope.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: List payments with compact payment ID, date, amount, status, account, and invoice references.

tools.name: create_payment
tools.description: Create a payment against an invoice, credit note, prepayment, or overpayment. Use list_accounts and get_invoice first to discover valid IDs and amounts.

tools.name: list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions with compact type, status, contact, date, total, and bank account details.

tools.name: create_bank_transaction
tools.description: Create a spend or receive bank transaction. Use list_accounts for valid bank/account codes and tax rates before calling this.

tools.name: list_manual_journals
tools.description: List manual journals with compact status, narration, date, journal ID, and line count.

tools.name: create_manual_journal
tools.description: Create a manual journal. Use this carefully; discover account codes with list_accounts and prefer DRAFT when supported by the organisation workflow.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List attachments for a supported Xero resource such as Invoices, Contacts, BankTransactions, CreditNotes, PurchaseOrders, or ManualJournals.

tools.name: read_attachment_content
tools.description: Extract readable text from an attachment on a supported Xero resource. Uses the shared file extractor for PDFs, Office files, CSV, text, HTML, and similar formats.

tools.name: get_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Get the Profit and Loss report for a date range or period. Returns Xero's report rows plus helper metadata for the query used.

tools.name: get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Get the Balance Sheet report for a date or period. Use this for financial position summaries.

tools.name: get_trial_balance
tools.description: Get the Trial Balance report at a point in time.

tools.name: get_bank_summary
tools.description: Get the Bank Summary report for a date range.

tools.name: get_aged_payables_by_contact
tools.description: Get the Aged Payables by Contact report for a supplier contact. Provide contactId from list_contacts.

tools.name: get_aged_receivables_by_contact
tools.description: Get the Aged Receivables by Contact report for a customer contact. Provide contactId from list_contacts.

tools.name: get_budget_summary
tools.description: Get the Budget Summary report for a date range and period count.
